Linde supplies industrial gases through three basic distribution methods: on-site or tonnage, merchant or bulk liquid, and packaged or cylinder gases, with the method chosen based on factors such as the customer's volume requirements and location [1]. On-site supply uses cryogenic and process gas plants built on or adjacent to the customer's site, with product delivered directly by pipeline, and these contracts generally run 10-20 years [1]. Merchant gas is produced at plants and delivered in liquid form, with merchant oxygen and nitrogen having a relatively small distribution radius, and these agreements are usually three to seven-year requirement contracts [2]. Customers requiring small volumes are supplied in metal cylinders under medium to high pressure, which may be delivered to the customer's site or picked up by the customer [2]. Linde also manufactures and distributes products through networks of production plants, pipeline complexes, distribution centers and delivery vehicles [3]. Linde carries inventories of merchant and cylinder gases to supply customers on a reasonable delivery schedule, while on-site plants and pipeline complexes have limited inventory [4].

notes: Retrieval quality rests on 25 textual questions, so its intervals are very wide. Their passage gold is v2's labels moved to the re-parsed chunks by exact text or word overlap (AI-labeled, cross-checked blind by a second model; no human spot check) (evals/eval-card.md).

Retrieval latency is measured at 11,375 chunks, in the eval process on this PC's CPU, each question a query in its company scope; the 250 ms target is for about 250k chunks, which this corpus cannot test.
Latency comes only from questions whose model calls were all live: 55 of 55.
Citation coverage is measured on the last reply before sentence removal; final answers are 100% covered by construction, since validation drops each sentence without a passing citation.
Judge metrics count: Cohen's kappa 0.84 against labels by claude, not by the judge.
Cost as billed is the prepaid credits Claude spends, from each call's usage, and $0 on the free tiers; the paid-equivalent uses the prices in evals/providers.json.
False refusals by cause: validation: no sentence held up 1 (c19); relevance gate 1 (x21); model: insufficient evidence 1 (x42).
